name: B10-0136/2024 (S&D) – Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking for action. It asks Azerbaijan to release people held for their political views, respect free speech and let independent journalists work. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on officials blamed for rights abuses, to review its energy deal with Azerbaijan, and to keep supporting Armenia and the Armenians who fled Nagorno-Karabakh.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests and opinions, not new rules.
- **Who it affects:** Azerbaijan's government, jailed activists and journalists, and Armenia.
- **What happens next:** The EU and its member states decide whether to act on these requests.
